commonNameZh: 志留纪齿旋软骨鱼干群
overview: A late Aeronian stem chondrichthyan known from twenty-three isolated tooth whorls rather than an articulated body or jaw.

ecology.diet: Undetermined; tooth whorls do not preserve feeding events
ecology.habitat: Rongxi Formation depositional setting; life habitat unresolved

evidenceSummary: IVPP V26641 and referred whorls directly record dentition and histology at about 439 Ma, but associated body anatomy, crown membership and global range remain unknown.

overview: A near-complete Telychian total-group chondrichthyan combining a scale-covered body and chondrichthyan-like branchial region with macromeric thoracic armour.

ecology.habitat: Huixingshao Formation depositional setting; life habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Aquatic body form preserved; performance not measured

evidenceSummary: The sole holotype IVPP V300000 supplies exceptional body-plan evidence while leaving exact stem placement, ecology and population variation unresolved.

commonNameZh: 泥盆纪镶嵌型软骨鱼干群
overview: A Givetian stem chondrichthyan known from one compressed specimen whose CT and histology reveal an anatomically incongruent character mosaic.

ecology.habitat: Lower Plattenkalk depositional setting; life habitat unresolved

traits: Scales and teeth preserved in one slab
evidenceSummary: UMZC 2000.32 documents multiple anatomical systems and chondrichthyan-stem placement, but compression, one individual and matrix sensitivity limit broader inference.

commonNameZh: 宽吻泥盆纪对称鳍鲨形软骨鱼
overview: A Famennian symmoriiform known from several near-complete, partly articulated skeletons, including three-dimensionally preserved neurocrania in AA.MEM.DS.12 and PIMUZ A/I 5159 with a broad rostrum and widely separated nasal capsules.

ecology.diet: PIMUZ A/I 5155 contains a more or less articulated small actinopterygian stomach content approximately 40 mm long, recording one feeding event; broader diet, habitat preference, locomotor performance and trophic guild remain unresolved
ecology.habitat: Famennian marine Thylacocephalan Layer; life-habitat preference unresolved
ecology.locomotion: High-aspect-ratio tail and large pectoral fins are preserved; performance was not measured
ecology.bodySize: Estimated in-life lengths of studied individuals are 0.8–2.5 m from specimen proportions

evidenceSummary: Several Moroccan specimens, including AA.MEM.DS.12 and PIMUZ A/I 5159, preserve articulated bodies and three-dimensional cranial anatomy. Published matrices place the new genus among early symmoriiforms, with alternative stem-holocephalan versus stem-elasmobranch interpretations retained.

commonNameZh: 具鳃盖的密西西比世对称鳍鲨形软骨鱼
overview: A Late Mississippian symmoriiform known from the partial holotype AMNH FF 20509, whose CT-based reconstruction reveals elongate fused branchial rays forming an operculate structure.

ecology.diet: Undetermined; tooth arrangement is preserved but prey use is not observed
ecology.habitat: Fayetteville Shale marine depositional setting; life-habitat preference unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Partial pectoral fins are preserved; locomotor performance was not measured

traits: Elongate fused pharyngeal-arch rays forming an operculum
Small cladodont teeth in widely spaced families
Fifteen to eighteen distal fin radials
evidenceSummary: The single partial holotype AMNH FF 20509 preserves lower jaws, a partial upper jaw and basicranium, branchial elements, pectoral cartilage, fins and teeth; CT and a phylogenetic analysis support a falcatid symmoriiform interpretation while preserving the limitations of one damaged specimen.
